name: PlanBridge AI
subtitle: Calendar & Trip Planner
promotionalText: Bring calendars and bookings into one clear timeline. Spot timing conflicts, review booking changes and check your trip plans before you set off.
description:
PlanBridge AI is a calendar planner and trip organizer that helps you spot booking conflicts before they disrupt your day. Bring selected Apple calendars and the bookings you add into one timeline, then review overlaps, changed times and the details that need attention.

SEE YOUR DAY CLEARLY
Choose the calendars you want to read. Add bookings yourself or review an ICS or structured JSON import before saving. Keep appointments, journeys and reservations together without giving PlanBridge permission to edit your Apple calendars.

CHECK BOOKING CONFLICTS
Compare the times in your supplied plans, inspect the evidence behind a warning and review booking updates. PlanBridge checks the information you provide; it cannot confirm that a transport service is running or that a reservation is valid.

ORGANIZE YOUR TRIPS
Group bookings into a trip and check them together. Three trip checks are included for personal plans. Driving estimates can be requested from Apple Maps using the locations you supply.

ASK ABOUT YOUR PLANS
Type a question about your bookings, conflicts or changes. Answers use local language rules and your supplied plans. No cloud AI, live airline, rail, hotel, restaurant or email service is connected.

YOUR PLANS STAY PERSONAL
No account is required. Plan data is stored on your device. Choose your calendars, manage your imports and use the available privacy controls. Voice recognition works on-device only, on supported devices and languages.

PLANBRIDGE PRO
Optional monthly or annual subscriptions provide unlimited trip checks and on-device voice questions where supported. Both plans offer the same benefits. Prices and billing periods are shown before purchase; the annual plan is billed upfront. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled in App Store settings. Restore purchases with the Apple Account used to subscribe.

PlanBridge is a planning aid. Missing information, unsupported imports and unavailable travel estimates can limit its checks. Always confirm important details with your booking provider.
